# Using this guide

This manual details how to:

- Create an account and navigate on GlobalArchive,

- Upload an [<u>Annotation Set</u>](http://127.0.0.1:61388/articles/user-guide/glossary.html#annotation-set), within a [<u>Campaign</u>](http://127.0.0.1:61388/articles/user-guide/glossary.html#campaign), within a [<u>Project</u>](http://127.0.0.1:61388/articles/user-guide/glossary.html#project),

- Create and upload a [<u>Synthesis</u>](http://127.0.0.1:61388/articles/user-guide/glossary.html#synthesissyntheses).

The manual is best used in an electronic form - as it uses links to linked supporting Appendices and external resources.
